buildPathPolicy.comp: Default for new major visual surfaces and substantial redesigns: homepage/landing surfaces, portfolio and project showcases, author/about pages, and major new sections. Generate comps before implementation to establish composition, hierarchy, rhythm, typography, imagery, and responsive intent; implementation should closely match the approved direction.
buildPathPolicy.code: Use for narrow utilitarian/content work and incremental work inside an established surface: article templates, tag/search/RSS surfaces, minor design-system extensions, small responsive/accessibility fixes, and maintenance where visual direction is fully defined.
